title: jmap-chat-types/jmap-filenode-types break public API without version bump
description: Both crates are published on crates.io at 0.1.2, and Cargo.toml still says 0.1.2 after this series. Breaking changes: (1) crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs:119,127: ChatMessageEntry.has_mention changes from bool to Option<bool>, has_mention_all is removed, mention_scopes is added, plaintext() takes Vec<String> in place of bool, and encrypted() drops two parameters. (2) crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/filter.rs:126: pub field type_match is renamed to media_type_match. (3) crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/filenode.rs: NodeType wire strings change (file->File, etc.) and FileNode's @type/mediaType wire names change, so existing data and peers using the -14 format no longer interoperate. Under Cargo semver, 0.1.2 -> 0.1.3 is treated as compatible, so a downstream crate with jmap-chat-types = "0.1" fails to compile after cargo update. Fix: bump both crates (and their dependents in the workspace) to 0.2.0 and record the breaks in the changelog. Same class as JMAP-6xs8.3, which covers jmap-types only.
